blocks.text: Why a Chauffeur Makes Sense in Tustin
Three practical reasons, specific to this city.
blocks.html: Three practical reasons, specific to this city.

items: Tustin Ranch streets are named after the former citrus ranch and the 18-hole golf course sits in the middle of the community, so a coach staging at one clubhouse pickup point can serve an entire group.
The Market Place draws heavy weekend parking demand and Jamboree Road backs up toward the I-5, SR 55 and SR 73 interchanges.
Old Town Tustin and Tustin Legacy Park events end at set times with heavy egress, so a pre-set pickup time matters.
SNA is about 8 miles away and the city sits between Santa Ana and Irvine, making it an ideal airport-drop city.

blocks.text: We also quote Tustin to the hour rather than the trip. blocks.text: Choosing a Vehicle for a Tustin Night

Capacity is the first filter, then cost per person. A stretch limo seats 6 to 8, a Chrysler 300 about 8, a Hummer 12, and a Sprinter limo up to 14. Our party bus seats 24. Below about ten people, two cars or a limo usually beats a bus. Above ten, the bus wins on cost per head and nobody gets left behind.
